episode.title: Handle with Care
intro: Mika gets access to confidential project files. She finds two versions of one financial report. Daichi says the newer one is correct, but they must keep old versions too. Later, the older report disappears from the shared folder.
ミカは機密のプロジェクト資料にアクセスします。彼女は同じ財務レポートが2つあることに気づきます。ダイチは新しい方が正しいと言いますが、古い版も残す必要があります。その後、共有フォルダから古いレポートが消えます。
goal: I can ask which report to use and explain a missing file.
使うレポートを尋ね、見当たらないファイルについて説明できる。
episode.warmup: When you see two versions of a file, what do you do?
words: These files are confidential, so please keep them inside the company.
This folder has research reports, budgets, and a proposal draft.
I found two versions of the same financial report.
two versions：2つの版（バージョン）
Which one is correct, the older one or the newer one?
Which one is correct?：どちらが正しいですか？
We adjusted several figures after the client's feedback.
adjusted several figures：数字をいくつか修正した
We need to preserve previous versions for reference.
preserve previous versions：以前の版を保存しておく
discussion: Talk with the tutor: Why do teams keep older versions of documents?
講師と話しましょう：なぜチームは古い版の資料も残しますか？
episode.followup: What is a polite way to ask someone to check a file?

rule: Ask clearly when you are not sure.
よく分からない時は、はっきり質問します。
examples: どのバージョンを使えばいいですか？

rule: Give a short reason with because.
becauseで短い理由を言います。
examples: Please do not delete it because we need it for reference.
参照が必要なので、削除しないでください。

situation: Mika talks with Daichi about two versions of a financial report and what to do next.
ミカがダイチと、財務レポートの2つの版と次の対応について話します。
dialogue: Daichi
Hi Mika. How is the file review going?
Mika
Hi Daichi. I found two versions of the same financial report.
Daichi
Good catch. The newer version is correct.
Mika
Okay. Should we delete the older one?
Daichi
Not yet. Please keep it for reference.
Mika
Understood. We keep old versions because we may need them later.
Daichi
The client gave us new information, so we changed some numbers.
Mika
Can you show me which report to use?
Daichi
Yes. Use the newer report. Keep the older one for reference.
Mika
Understood. I will use the new report and keep the old one.
questions: Two versions of the same financial report.
Should they delete the older version now?
No. They should keep it for reference.
Because of the client's latest feedback.

choose: I found (two versions / two lunches) of the report.
We (adjusted / ignored) several figures after feedback.
Please (preserve / break) the old version for reference.
Should we (delete / buy) the older file?
choices: Daichi says the correct report is the ____ one.
Daichi says, 'Do not delete it ____ we need it for reference.'
Mika asks Daichi to ____ which file name to use.

situation: You are Mika. You speak to Ethan about a missing older report in the shared folder.
あなたはミカです。共有フォルダから古いレポートが消えた件を、イーサンに話します。
task: Explain what you saw and ask what to do next. Use polite questions.
見たことを説明し、次にどうするか丁寧に質問してください。
mission.title: Missing Older Report
lines: Mika, what did you notice in the shared folder?
What did Daichi say about the older report?
Do you know why it is missing?
What should we check before deciding what happened?
mission.evidence: The newer financial report is correct after the client's feedback. Daichi said to keep the older report for reference. Later Mika cannot find it. She does not know who moved it or why. Do not claim it was deleted or leaked.
useful: Should we keep the old one?

topics: Do you name files with dates?
How do you choose the newest version?
Do you keep old versions? Why?
What information is confidential at work?
Where should you store confidential files?
Who do you ask when you are not sure?
What is a polite question you use?
Do you ask by chat, email, or in person?
trivia: Many teams keep a 'version history' so they can see what changed and when.
多くのチームは「版の履歴」を残し、いつ何が変わったか確認します。
triviaQuestion: What is the record of file changes called?
episode.closing: Mika learns the newer report is correct, but the older version should be kept. Later, she notices the older report has disappeared from the shared folder.
